products.name: Wavve
products.note: Audio-to-video AI; podcast clips; waveform videos; social media content

profile_text.body:
Wavve is an audio-to-video tool operated under the Disctopia brand, aimed primarily at podcasters and audio content creators. The company describes itself as a platform that turns audio into short, shareable video clips suited for social media distribution, and it offers users a custom wavve.link podcast page as part of its service.

The platform's core product, also called Wavve, falls into the video generation and editing category and centers on waveform-style video creation from audio files. The site describes an AI highlights feature that is designed to identify key moments within audio content and convert them into clips intended for broader social sharing. No financial figures, litigation, or regulatory filings appear in the available data.
